title: Spar implementation

acceptance_criteria.description: Implement entire configured Spar service contract, starting with a real native/Go process comparison.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: No runtime embedding/stubs for supported SAML/IdP/SCIM users/groups/tokens/internal paths; early config/health/version/error/lifecycle real reference comparison. Preserve API/schema/state/permission/cert/issuer/replay/cookie/legacy/v2 behaviour from frozen source.

acceptance_criteria.description: Validate final exact Spar executable and finite supported matrix.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Pinned Go format/tidy/verify/vet/unit/race/build/vulnerability/license; reviewed dependency trust boundaries and finite frozen gap/security/state tests. All225 original seven-Go/Haskell peer executions pass strict XML/names/no error/skip, exact selected artifact identities and mandatory owned cleanup. Retain failures/unrun native checks; no oracle weakening or speculative extra gates.

acceptance_criteria.description: Demonstrate operational optional service and durable Haskell-Go-Haskell recovery.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: One predeclared finite concurrency/latency/RSS/CPU/counters and loaded shutdown smoke; actual same-state IdP/token/SCIM/group/mapping/pending-SAML/verdict/replay switchback. Exact trusted nonroot optional image/config/CA lifecycle; separately scoped optional image-only selector preserving RollingUpdate/defaults. Complete delegated same-author review, serious inherited concerns documented without repairing Haskell/security policy.

handoff: Progress: real native/Go schema23 startup and clean SIGTERM executed. First six-response comparison failed on health Content-Type and response Request-Id; failure retained under module qualification/evidence/early-719cd. Go corrected using actual native output and middleware source; full pinned checks pass. Repeat exact corrected comparison next. Full SSO/IdP/SCIM, original225, storage/operations/switchback/image/selector remain incomplete; compatibility null.
